tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Use when checking where teams rank in their division or conference. Returns points, wins, losses, OT losses, point%, goal differential, goals for/against per game, and 5v5 possession: Corsi%, Fenwick% and expected goals for and against. The possession columns are 5v5 only, so they will not match a g

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Use when you need full details for one team: record, goals for and against, league rank, and 5v5 possession (Corsi%, Fenwick%, expected goals for and against). Possession is 5v5 only. Requires a team abbreviation (use list_teams if unsure). Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Use when you need team abbreviations, or to see all 32 active NHL teams with city, conference, division, and arena. Excludes historical franchises (ATL, ARI). Cheapest tool at 1 credit.

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Use when querying past or future games with filters. Returns scores, teams, venue, and game metadata. For upcoming-only games, prefer get_schedule (2 cr) instead. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use when checking what games are coming up. Returns only unplayed future games for the next N days (default 7). For past games, use get_games instead. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_game_detail
tools.description: Use when you need everything about one game: both teams' full info, all betting odds, and the goalies who started, with their time on ice. Requires a game ID (get one from get_games or get_schedule). Odds for every game from 2019-20 on (and part of the 2019 playoffs). Goalie starts are derived from

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Use when comparing two teams' history. Returns recent matchups with win/loss record. Can filter by season or get all-time. Costs 10 credits.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use when looking up a player by name. Searches 4,900+ players across every season since 2010-11. Returns active players by default; set active=false for retired/historical. Use the returned player ID with get_player_stats for full details. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Use when you need full details for one player: bio, team, and physical attributes. For skaters, also returns the latest season line (games, goals, assists, points, +/-, PP/SH, shooting%, TOI). For goalies, save%, GAA, GSAX, and trend data. Requires player ID from search_players. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_goalie_stats
tools.description: Use when ranking goalies or comparing goalie performance. Returns a leaderboard sorted by save%, GAA, GSAX, or wins, with a games-played filter. Includes goals saved above expected, high-danger save%, rolling save% and GSAX over the last 10 appearances, form trend and rest days. Goalie expected goal

tools.name: get_skater_season_stats
tools.description: Use when ranking skaters or comparing scoring. Returns a leaderboard sorted by points, goals, assists, plus/minus, or shots, with a games-played filter. Includes power play and shorthanded production, shooting%, faceoff%, and average time on ice. Seasons from 2010-11 on. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_player_game_log
tools.description: Use when you need a player's game-by-game stat lines for a season, not a season total. For skaters: date, opponent, home/away, goals, assists, points, shots, PIM and power-play points for each game. For goalies: date, opponent, home/away, decision, shots against, saves, goals against and save% for e

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Use when checking betting lines. Pass game_id for one game (10 credits): moneyline, puck line and total by bookmaker, opening and closing. Or pass season (optionally with team) for a whole season of closing lines in one call, with final scores, at 10 credits per game returned (a full season is ~13,7

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Use when analyzing how betting lines moved over time. Returns time-series snapshots grouped by bookmaker. Most expensive tool (25 cr). tools.name: get_player_props
tools.description: Use for player prop lines by sportsbook: over/under on points, goals, assists, shots on goal, blocked shots, goalie saves and anytime goal scorer, from May 2023 (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, ESPN BET, Pinnacle and others). Pass game_id for every player's props in one game, or player_id with from_dat

tools.name: get_prop_history
tools.description: Use to see how a player did against his prop line over time: for one market (points, goals, assists, shots on goal, blocked shots, goalie saves or anytime goal scorer), one row per game with the closing line (the median across books, or one book's), the opening line (the same as the close wherever o

tools.name: get_plays
tools.description: Use for play-by-play events: goals, shots, misses, blocks, faceoffs, hits, giveaways, takeaways, penalties, with rink coordinates, strength state (5v5, 5v4), zone, and the players involved. tools.name: get_shot_map
tools.description: Use when you want shot locations rather than a list of events: every shot attempt with rink coordinates, shot type, strength, shooter and goalie. Filter by game, or by season plus a team or player. Paginated: follow next_offset, since a season runs past one page and pages are chronological. Costs 10

tools.name: get_shifts
tools.description: Use for who was on the ice and when: every player's shifts in one NHL game, each with period, start and end (period clock and seconds from the opening faceoff) and duration, plus the official boxscore time on ice and plus/minus. Filter to one team or player. NHL games from 2010-11 on. Costs 10 credi

tools.name: get_situation_time
tools.description: Use for exact time at each strength: the seconds each team spent at 5v5, 5v4, 4v5, 4v4, 6v5 with the goalie pulled and every other on-ice state in an NHL game, split into regulation and overtime, from the shift charts. Also even / power-play / shorthanded totals, goalie-pulled seconds, period length

tools.name: get_predictions
tools.description: Use for the model's win probability for each NHL game on the current slate: home and away win probability, the A/B/C confidence grade, start time, plus the model version and when the slate was generated. tools.description: Paid plans only (not available on the free plan).
